scenarios.label: Retail
scenarios.note: 20 typical buys spread across the fee window. Not a forecast.

scenarios.label: Whale
scenarios.note: Five buys at 8× the typical size, placed at launch while the early fee is highest.

scenarios.label: Late capital
scenarios.note: Some size arrives at launch. The rest arrives later in the fee window. When that starts depends on the asset profile.

scenarios.label: Sell pressure
scenarios.note: Buyers take a position, then sell 35% of the base they received.

scenarios.label: Volatile
scenarios.note: Alternating buys and partial sells. A dynamic fee is replayed when the config has one.
